title: GeoSync Release Evidence Bundle
description: A single schema-validated release evidence bundle (task REL-011). It enumerates, per evidence category, the backing artifact path(s), each artifact's sha256, and a present/absent status. It does NOT duplicate the underlying artifacts; it REFERENCES them. A category is mandatory when its receipt is required to declare a release ready. If any mandatory category is not fully PRESENT the release_readiness verdict is NOT_READY (the gate is RED — an honest 'release not ready' signal, never a fabricated green). The bundle is regenerated deterministically (sorted keys, fixed content -> identical bytes) by scripts/ci/check_release_evidence.py.

release_version.description: Version SSOT, must equal VERSION and CITATION.cff version (1.1.0).

commit.description: Canonical release commit sha (read from the REL-005 provenance manifest, not live git, so regen is deterministic across later commits).

provenance_ref.description: Path to the REL-005 canonical provenance manifest that pins commit/tree/tag.

verdict.description: READY iff every mandatory category is fully PRESENT. NOT_READY otherwise (gate RED).

missing_mandatory.description: Mandatory categories not fully PRESENT. Non-empty -> verdict NOT_READY.

status.description: PRESENT: all artifacts present AND content-satisfied. MISSING: none present. PARTIAL: some present, some missing. UNSATISFIED: at least one artifact is present but fails its receipt-content contract (garbage/empty/FAIL/below-floor). INVALID: reserved for a category whose artifact is present but structurally unusable.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the referenced evidence artifact (present) or the canonical location where the mandatory receipt WOULD live (missing).

sha256.description: sha256 of the file on disk (any on-disk status) or null (MISSING). Never fabricated.

status.description: PRESENT: on disk and content-satisfied. MISSING: no file. UNSATISFIED: on disk, parseable, but fails the receipt-content contract (missing shape / FAIL verdict / match:false / below floor). INVALID: on disk but empty / not JSON / wrong top-level type.

reason.description: Short human explanation present when status is UNSATISFIED or INVALID.

task.description: Originating remediation task id, if any.

verdict.description: Recorded verdict carried by this artifact (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, PASS), read live from the artifact.
